name: sim-ws-resync
notes: A server-initiated resync and the client's re-sub (BUS-07, API.md §6.3 step 7). GENERATED by providers/sim/prng.ts, for the reason TESTING §8 records for sim-ws-burst: the one recorded poll carries one seqno, so a session in which a feed keeps running across a plant restart cannot be recorded. Two subjects at 5 Hz. At 700 ms the plant calls forceResync for q:1 — a plant restart or an entitlement reload — and the subscriber drops the subscription, sends resync { subjects: ['q:1'] } and suppresses every later tick of that subject, which is the whole point: recovery is a fresh snapshot, never replayed deltas, because the composite is the truth and there is no delta log (BUS-07). At 1 100 ms the client re-subs and the next flush carries a snap at whatever seq the plant has reached by then, with q:2 still on its unbroken prev chain throughout.
